scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install && cd apps/server && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv uv sync
scripts.dev:server: cd apps/server && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv uv run uvicorn server.main:create_app --factory --reload --port 8000
scripts.test:server: cd apps/server && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=.venv uv run pytest
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:web
